propositions: The caused_by auto-derivation mechanism falls back to git blame over impacted file paths when no explicit caused_by is supplied, and this edge is used to weight escape-rate metrics and the epic-close caused_by floor

A provenance marker distinguishing blame-derived edges from explicitly supplied edges does not exist in the recorded link events, making it impossible to retrospectively identify which edges are guesses vs explicit attributions

Against 88 closed bugs carrying caused_by edges, the real derive_caused_by mechanism reproduces 38 recorded edges (agree), differs from 6 (disagree), and abstains on 44 (50% fail-closed via >50% majority rule)

On the 8 bugs with independently proven origins from debug protocol, the deriver reproduced zero correct attributions and named an innocent target once; the other 7 fail closed, indicating the mechanism struggles with unmet obligations, carrier commits, and omissions
File-level blame scatters attribution for bug families that were batch-attributed to one origin ticket, demonstrating structural limits of per-bug file blame on multi-bug defect families
